title: A lot of potential
author: Physical_Outcome_536
selftext: I have created around 10 indicators that have been backed by bar by for the last 3-4 years based of historical data and everyy one of them is profitable by at least 1% on any account size every month . It doesn’t repaint or any of the stuff that makes indicators useless . They’re all working as should be and tested . It’s a shame they only work through pine connector  to get them automated but if anyone else is like this please let me know. I make them for fun and now it’s time I start putting them on funded accounts. I calculated it and backtested every trade for a certain months across all indicators for different year after making sure it doesn’t repaint or misfire and now I can confirm that   It’s profitable and all 4 months I tested gave me over 10% return on whatever account size as long as they were the same size. I don’t know if this is something that people have created but I’m struggling testing these on real accounts not actually making them which I find funny

comments.author: evilistics
comments.body: Use ai to create a bridge to take webhook alerts from tv to send to your broker through API to open and close trades. I created one as a plugin for wordpress that I host on a cheap VPS. I've connected it to hyper liquid and bybit but can connect it to any broker that has decent API documentation. Bybit is a great way to test it as it's demo accounts use real pricing and incorporates actual fees in every trade so you'll see if those factors will impact your strategy.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: ten of them all green every single month for three or four years would worry me rather than reassure me. real edges have flat stretches and ugly months. no repaint only means the signal was honest about when it fired, it says nothing about whether the fills you assumed in the test are the ones you would get. run one forward on a small live account before any of them go near an evaluation.
